title: Mentor-Gated Registration Flow
description: See how registering mentors first turns a 3:1 ratio into a capacity limit the software enforces, instead of a rule mentors have to police.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Choosing a Schedule and Building Registration

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a mentor sign-up count, the learner correctly calculates the resulting student registration capacity and traces what happens once that capacity is reached.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin flowchart with a capacity calculation and a waiting-list branch
pedagogical.assessment: Give a mentor count and ask for the resulting capacity and what happens to the next family who signs up.
